name: Human
gmNotes: In ordinary project metadata, Species is Human or Fey. Human covers all biologically human people — naturally born humans, Takelings (Humans taken in infancy and raised by the Fey), and human-derived clones, whether born or grown from a pattern. Takelings carry the Takeling (provenance) archetype; Clones carry the Clone (provenance) archetype. A Changeling is a particular clone pattern or role (a clone replacement grown and imprinted to replace an abducted human baby) — not a separate Species, and not Fey. Classification is explicit and flat: a character stores every applicable archetype directly; never infer Takeling, Clone, or Changeling through an inherited chain.
description: The native people of this world — farmers, smiths, herdsfolk, and storytellers, born of flesh and blood and the long green land. Humans live lives measured by seasons and harvests, and they keep the old stories about the Fair Folk even after they stop believing them.
